name: Hajiyome Osanazuma Oshioki Adventure
original_name: はじよめ 幼な妻おしおきアドベンチャー
source:
Main character is a university student with parents away from home for a few weeks. Knowing it,  childhood friend comes to the house claiming herself wife of onii-chan. She performs various household chores and tries to get liked by protagonist. Where will this strange cohabitation lead? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名大学生，父母要离家数周。青梅竹马得知后跑到他家，自称是“哥哥的新娘”。她包办各种家务，努力讨主角喜欢。这段奇妙的同居生活会走向何方？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
